text: Thank you for sharing your history. speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Since your symptoms are more pronounced on the right side, have you noticed any double vision, drooping eyelids, or slurred speech alongside the clumsiness? Additionally, do you have a history of autoimmune conditions like Graves' disease or thyroid disorders?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.
